answer_q: What is a custom AI agent?
answer: A custom AI agent is software built for one business task that uses a large language model to decide the steps and tools such as your CRM, email or documents to carry them out. Unlike a chatbot, it works through multi-step jobs in the background and asks a person to approve sensitive actions.
body:
When a custom AI agent is the right tool

Simple, predictable processes are best handled by workflow automation. Conversations with customers suit a chatbot or AI receptionist. A custom agent earns its place when a task needs judgement across several steps and systems, the kind of work you would normally give a capable junior staff member with clear instructions.

Signs a custom agent fits:

  • the task involves reading, deciding and then acting in more than one system
  • each case is slightly different, so fixed rules keep breaking
  • the steps are well understood, but they take hours every week
  • mistakes are recoverable, or a person can approve the final action

Examples of custom AI agents we build

Lead qualification agent

Reads every new enquiry, researches the company, scores the lead against your criteria, writes a personal reply, books qualified leads into a sales call and updates the CRM. Your sales team starts each day with a ranked list instead of a messy inbox.

Inbox triage agent

Sorts a shared inbox by topic and urgency, drafts replies to routine questions from your knowledge base, routes complex cases to the right person with a summary, and flags anything overdue.

Quote preparation agent

Collects job details, photos and measurements, checks your price list and past jobs, drafts a quote in your template and sends it to a person for one-click approval.

Research and reporting agent

Gathers information from your systems and approved sources, compares it with last period, and writes a plain-English summary for managers or clients.

How our agents stay safe and accurate

  1. Narrow permissions: each agent can only see and do what its task requires.
  2. Approval points: sending money, contracts, external emails above a risk level or anything irreversible waits for a person.
  3. Grounded inputs: agents work from your data and approved sources, not guesses.
  4. Full action log: every step the agent takes is recorded, so you can see what it did and why.
  5. Evaluation before launch: we test on real past cases and measure accuracy before the agent touches live work.

This mirrors the “test and monitor” and “maintain human control” practices in the Australian Government’s Guidance for AI Adoption, and our privacy design follows the OAIC’s AI product guidance.

The technology behind our agents

We build agents on leading models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google, chosen per task for reasoning quality, speed and cost. Agents connect to your systems through their APIs, using tools such as n8n for orchestration where that keeps things simpler to maintain. You own the configuration, prompts and logs, and we document how each agent works so your team understands it.

How a custom agent project runs

  1. Free AI audit: we pick one task with clear value and manageable risk.
  2. Task design: we document the steps, decisions, tools and approval points with the people who do the work today.
  3. Build and evaluate: we build the agent and test it against real past cases.
  4. Supervised launch: the agent runs with a person approving its output until accuracy is proven.
  5. Scale and improve: approvals are relaxed where safe, and we report monthly on time saved and accuracy.

Most custom agents take four to six weeks from kick-off to supervised launch. See all our AI agents, or start with AI strategy if you have several candidate tasks.

Questions to ask before building an AI agent

Before we build, we work through a short checklist with you: what exactly counts as a finished task, which systems the agent needs, which actions must always be approved, what a mistake would cost, and how you will know the agent is performing. Clear answers to these questions are the difference between an agent that saves hours every week and one that creates extra checking work. If the answers aren’t clear yet, our AI consulting team can help you get there.
faqs: What is the difference between an AI agent and automation?

Automation follows fixed steps you define in advance. An AI agent decides the steps itself based on the goal and the information in front of it, which suits tasks where every case is a little different.
Can an AI agent act without a person checking?
Only where you decide it is safe. We start every agent with approval steps for important actions, then relax them for low-risk tasks once accuracy has been measured on real work.
Which systems can a custom AI agent use?
Any system with an API or email access, including CRMs like HubSpot and Zoho, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, accounting software like Xero, and internal databases.
How much does a custom AI agent cost?
It depends on the number of steps, systems and the level of testing needed. We quote a fixed price in AUD after a free audit, plus a monthly fee for hosting, AI usage and monitoring.
